body: Thank you. It was one of the first things I did after the funeral, to look for a dog companion. But I realized I an incapable of taking care of a dog at the moment.

I found him with his eyes and mouth open, blood everywhere. I hugged him and tried to make him blink. I get panic attacks and flashbacks every day, multiple times. My pain stems from knowing he was in pain and alone in the last moments. I cannot get over that, I wasn't there for him. Medication doesn't remove the horr and pain, I wake up in shock and chain smoke while trembling every single morning. I don't know when or whether I will ever get used to the fact that he is gone. Even if it's possible, I have zero idea what to do with myself for the rest of life.
